name: yaniv-claude-config
description: Personal Claude Code marketplace: project-agnostic workflow plugins that travel between machines.

plugins.name: pr-workflows
plugins.description: Forge-agnostic pull/merge request workflow — create, review, comment inline, verify CI, resolve threads, fix conflicts. Works on GitHub and GitLab.

plugins.name: dev-workflows
plugins.description: Planning, TDD, subagent-driven execution, worktree isolation, a pre-push quality gate, and /ship — the end-to-end feature delivery pipeline.

plugins.name: issue-tracker
plugins.description: Jira ticket creation and status transitions with site, project keys and status aliases in a machine-local config, plus templated Linear issue creation.

plugins.name: infra-workflows
plugins.description: Add env vars to a service's Helm values across GitOps registries, and provision AWS SSM SecureString parameters per environment with an account guard.

plugins.name: cmux
plugins.description: Control the cmux terminal multiplexer — topology, workspaces, browser surface, notifications.
